summary: VEON MidCo B.V., a subsidiary of VEON Ltd., announced the final results of its tender offer for up to $1.014 billion of its 3.375% Notes due 2027. The offer expired on June 16, 2026, with $936 million validly tendered by the early deadline and $886 million accepted at a proration factor of 0.9229. The company satisfied the New Financing Condition and paid the Early Tender Offer Purchase Price plus accrued interest. No additional notes were tendered after the early deadline. Accepted notes were cancelled, leaving approximately $128 million outstanding. This is a liability management transaction, reducing debt and interest expense. What to watch: remaining note liquidity and any subsequent refinancing.
